overview_description.description:
Lumoid is a go-to source for anything and everything that matters in the world of photography gear. It aims to offer the most reliable information available for photographers, gear enthusiasts, techies, smartphone users, drone pilots, and anyone interested in the latest breakthroughs in imaging technology.

Lumoid is a company based out of San Francisco, CA, United States.
